provenance.source_provider: www.binance.com public klines endpoint (column 5 quote asset volume)

pre_stated_hypothesis.name: Volume-Expansion Breakout Confirmation Continuation
pre_stated_hypothesis.description: Causal rolling z-score of real quote_volume_usdt; a vol-scaled short-term breakout (|ret6|/RV72 > 1.25) trades CONTINUATION in the breakout direction (long if ret6>0, short if ret6<0) ONLY when volume is EXPANDING (vol_z > 0.0 and rising vs prior bar) as breakout confirmation. Exit on vol_z <= 0.0 (expansion ended), max hold, or direction flip. Execution shifted t->t+1. Triggers on volume-expansion confirmation, neither C41 low-vol dry-up nor C23 high-vol surge momentum nor C40 high-vol climax fade — genuinely different regime and mechanic.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c23: C23 = momentum on HIGH vol surge (vol_z high) riding ret24 direction, no breakout confirmation. C42 = breakout continuation only on volume-expansion confirmation (rising non-negative vol_z), different trigger regime.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c40: C40 = mean reversion/FADE on HIGH vol climax (opposite of ret24). C42 = continuation on volume-expansion breakout confirmation (same direction), not a fade, different regime.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c41: C41 = continuation on LOW vol_z dry-up (vol_z < -1.0). C42 = continuation on volume EXPANSION (vol_z > 0.0 and rising), opposite volume regime and trigger.

config.benchmark: buy-and-hold per asset (gross, no recurring turnover) on union of OOS WF windows; strategy net of fee+slippage on turnover
config.pre_stated_oos_edge_proven_rule: oos_edge_proven=true IFF executed exposure>0 AND for ALL cost-grid slices OOS net sum > 0 AND OOS net sum > B&H OOS sum on same OOS windows. Else false (fail-closed).

honest_assessment: NO PROVEN NET-OF-COST OOS EDGE. oos_edge_proven=false for all tested assets under pre-stated fail-closed rule.
